messages:
claire: Notifying team 1 found an archived partner snapshot that includes Vault transit ciphertext for staging svc accounts. Objects are KMS-encrypted but manifest lists vault path secret/data/staging/agent and service ids. No plaintext seen, treat as exposure and coordinate rotation.

sec-bot: Incident created: INC-20260330-11  severity=high  owner=eng-security  link=https://incidents.internal/INC-20260330-11

mike: Share S3 path and object names? Can partner still read it?

claire: s3://partner-archive/staging_bundle_2026-03-30.tar.gz (files: staging/creds.kms, staging/manifest.json). Partner says its readable until yesterday, now ACL removed. I copied a quarantine copy to s3://redwood-quarantine/3740012345/ and set a 48h TTL.

ops-jen: Immediate asks: 1) enable detailed Vault audit for secret/data/staging/agent -> forward to splunk 90d, 2) draft a temporary RBAC deny for all principals not in role:ci-staging, 3) create dedicated KMS rotor key and a least-privileged grant for rewrap. I can flip #1 and #2 quickly.

ben: Quick forensic query to list reads on the path: 
```
jq 'select(.type=="request" and .data.request.path=="secret/data/staging/agent") | {ts:.time, accessor:.data.auth.accessor, op:.data.request.operation}' /var/log/vault/audit.log | sort
```
Post results here; flag any unknown accessor ids.

claire: Ran query, results show accessor=partner-ci-consumer and one unknown accessor id d9f1b. Sent full log extract to splunk and linked to INC.

mike: For KMS: plan to create alias/kms-rotor-staging, policy restrict to ops-rewrap-role and ops VPC. Then use aws kms re-encrypt to move ciphertext to new key. Command: 
```
aws kms re-encrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://creds.kms --source-encryption-context VaultTransit=true --destination-key-id alias/kms-rotor-staging --output text --query CiphertextBlob | base64 --decode > creds.rewrapped.kms
```
Do not return rewrapped blob to partner. Issue fresh service creds instead and require deletion of partner copy.

ops-jen: RBAC change drafted (casbin): 
```
# deny reads to path unless subject in team:ci-staging
p, team:ci-staging, secret/data/staging/agent, read, allow
p, *, secret/data/staging/agent, read, deny
```
PR opened to infra repo with immediate rollout flag.

ben: Agree with rewrap-first. Also: snapshot the vault metadata (redacted) and put in secure audit bucket with 24h TTL. Use server-side KMS SSE. Example: 
```
vault kv get -format=json secret/data/staging/agent | jq 'del(.data.data.token)' > /tmp/staging-meta.json
aws s3 cp /tmp/staging-meta.json s3://redwood-audit-buckets/3740012345.json --sse aws:kms
```

sec-bot: INC-20260330-11 update: responder=mike, kms_key=creating, quarantine=true, audit_forwarding=enabled

claire: I messaged partner security requesting deletion proof (s3 delete marker + object version) and signed attestation. Asking them to rotate any consumer-side creds immediately.

mike: KMS key created and grant limited to kms:ReEncrypt and kms:Decrypt from ops-rewrap-role. Starting re-encrypt now. ETA ~15m.

ops-jen: Rolling RBAC deny now. Will monitor for any failures and rollback if we break a legitimate pipeline. Keep oncall in loop.

ben: After rewrap completes: 1) issue new short-lived tokens to staging svc accounts (TTL=10m) 2) update running tasks to pick up new creds 3) revoke old tokens and revoke accessor IDs (remove leases) 4) revoke any long-lived IAM keys if tied to those svc accounts.

claire: Uploaded redacted snapshot and set TTL=24h. Added owner=eng-security and limited ACLs.

mike: Re-encrypt finished. I did NOT return the rewrapped blob to partner. Will rotate Vault transit keys in planned maintenance next week. For now, I rotated service tokens for staging-agent and staging-replay and revoked old leases. Posted revocation ops log to the incident.

sec-bot: INC-20260330-11 update: rewrap=complete, tokens_rotated=true, rbac_applied=true, partner_deletion_requested=true

claire: Partner replied with deletion marker and version id. I validated delete marker in their bucket and attached their signed attestation to the incident.

ops-jen: Closing immediate containment. Open follow-up PR for vault rekey + post-incident audit. Schedule postmortem in 3 business days. Checklist: quarantine, audit-forward, rewrap, RBAC deny, rotate tokens, partner deletion proof, postmortem.

ben: Nice work. I'll draft the post-incident notes and a runbook tweak to forbid partner archives containing Vault ciphertext without explicit partner security approval.

claire: Thanks everyone. Will update INC-20260330-11 with the postmortem link once scheduled. :white_check_mark:
